source.title: 202604_LIXIL_玄関ドア受発注資料集_完成品価格表.pdf

extraction.task: Resolve Giesta2 Phase7 blockers P7-B01 and P7-B02 by extracting explicit LIXIL official option/order codes from IG3500 without mutating Product Master.
extraction.prompt: Read only printed pages g6-g13 and g72-g77, corresponding to PDF pages 150-157 and 216-221, of the verified official LIXIL IG3500 2026-04 entrance-door order material. Extract atomic Evidence Candidates only for explicit LIXIL official option/order/product codes that map to existing Giesta2 Phase7 Option Master items. The allowed subject field is official_option_code only. Each candidate claim must identify the existing Option Master option_id when the page wording uniquely maps to it, followed by the exact official code, for example 'GST2_OPT_ELOCK_BUTTON official_option_code = Z-304-DVBB'. Prioritize the existing blocked items for FamiLock accessories and the option items on g72-g77 such as sill/plinth, kickplate, upper-door LED, wreath hook and cast ornaments/accessories. Do not treat a manufacturer/device model number such as EK3850W or VL-SVE710KF as the LIXIL official order code when the page separately shows a LIXIL product code. If a page shows a code template with color/handing/placeholders, preserve the template exactly and do not invent a completed code. If one source row could map to more than one existing option_id, if a variant rule is unclear, or if no explicit code is printed, return an issue instead of a candidate. Do not evaluate high-size H2530/H2730 compatibility in this job. Do not approve, adjudicate, or write Authoring Master, Runtime, Registry, Production, Canonical or Drive working Master files.
